reviewMethod: Representative frames every 60 seconds across the complete 33:14 source, then 10-second frames around the lap boundary, restart and final finish; original finish frame visually read.
observations: Explanation uses iOS video playback, pauses, seeking, drawings and repeated segments.
Early demonstration stops at a 39.05 first-lap boundary; later demonstration reaches CLEAR 1:18.23 around 32:05.
Final segment rewinds to about 57.42–1:00.88; those are intermediate race clocks, not completed totals.
No faster completed total was observed; the 1:18.23 result is slower than the existing 1:18.20 WR tie.
limitations: Tutorial editing and seeking prevent a claim of uninterrupted race continuity.
No lap split from a separate demonstrated segment is assigned to this result.
Review of representative frames is sufficient for the observed completed result, not an exhaustive frame-by-frame worldwide-history census.
